args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation plans document:

Items to Pack:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents
- Comfortable shoes for hiking
- Beach towel
- Water bottle
- Light clothing for the beach
- Rain jacket (for unexpected weather)
- Snorkeling gear (if not rented)
- Travel adapter
- Personal hygiene items
- Medication (if needed)
- Entertainment (books, games, etc.)

Additional Notes:
- Check the weather forecast for the dates of your trip.
- Ensure all travel documents are up to date.
- Consider packing a reusable bag for shopping trips.
- Bring a hat and sunglasses for sun protection.
- Pack a small first-aid kit for emergencies.

Enjoy your trip to Hawaii!
